title: Family of Baterbonia bars vloggers from his gravesite

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — As construction begins on his mausoleum, the family of the late basketball standout Rene Baterbonia has appealed to online content creators to stop filming and taking photographs at his gravesite in Talacogon, Agusan del Sur. In a public statement posted on social media, Baterbonia’s mother, Rovelyn, requested vloggers and visitors to respect the site’s solemnity and observe the family’s boundaries. “Good evening po sa lahat ng blogger na bawal na ang pag-video sa puntod ng aking anak dahil simula bukas ay magpapagawa na kami ng bahay para sa puntod ng aking anak,” Rovelyn wrote Monday […]...
